silicium.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for all Silicium optimizations.
silicium.option.static_chests.tooltip: Closed chests (normal, trapped, ender, copper) become part of the terrain mesh instead of being drawn one by one every frame. Huge FPS gain in storage rooms and farms with many chests. Opening animation still works. Chests are also visible at any distance.
silicium.option.occlusion_culling.toolti: Skips entities and block entities (chests, signs, banners...) hidden behind solid blocks. Computed on a background thread, so it costs almost nothing on the render thread. Biggest gains in bases, cities and caves. Automatically disabled when the EntityCulling mod is installed.
silicium.option.entity_distance.tooltip: Mobs, animals, minecarts etc. further than this are not rendered. Bosses and large mobs are always rendered.
silicium.option.item_distance.tooltip: Dropped items and experience orbs further than this are not rendered.
silicium.option.item_frame_distance.tool: Item frames (including map walls) and paintings further than this are not rendered. Map art walls are very expensive.
silicium.option.armor_stand_distance.too: Armor stands further than this are not rendered.
silicium.option.block_entity_distance.to: Block entities (chests, signs, banners, skulls, shulker boxes...) further than this are not rendered.
silicium.option.particle_distance.toolti: Particles further than this are never created.
silicium.option.always_players.tooltip: Other players are never hidden by distance or occlusion culling (recommended for PvP).
silicium.option.always_named.tooltip: Entities with a custom name or the glowing effect are never hidden.
silicium.option.single_item_model.toolti: Vanilla draws up to 5 copies of the model for a stack of dropped items. Enabled = only 1 copy (up to 5x less geometry).
silicium.option.max_items_per_block.tool: How many dropped items, XP orbs and arrows in the same block are rendered. Helps a lot with farms and dropped inventories.
silicium.option.max_mobs_per_block.toolt: How many mobs in the same block are rendered. Mob farms and animal pens often stack dozens of mobs in one block.
silicium.option.animation_lod_distance.t: Mobs further than this animate at a lower rate (legs, head, equipment are refreshed less often). Movement stays smooth. Close mobs are always fully animated, players are never affected. Off = full animation everywhere.
silicium.option.distant_animation_fps.to: How many times per second distant mobs update their animation at the LOD start distance. Further away it drops gradually (half at twice the distance). Lower = more FPS with many mobs.
silicium.option.max_tnt_per_block.toolti: How many primed TNT and falling blocks (sand/gravel) in the same block are rendered. Huge help for TNT and sand cannons.
How many explosion smoke effects can appear in a single tick. Explosions still break blocks and knock back normally.
silicium.option.max_explosion_sounds_per: How many explosion sounds can play in a single tick.
silicium.option.explosion_debris.tooltip: Block debris particles after explosions. Disabling helps a lot with big explosions.
silicium.option.max_particles.tooltip: Hard cap on the number of live particles. Vanilla allows over 16000 per group. Fewer particles = less to update and render.
silicium.option.bubble_column_percent.to: Percentage of bubbles shown in bubble columns above soul sand and magma. 100% = vanilla, 0% = none. Water elevators keep working normally.
silicium.option.hide_spawner_mobs.toolti: Does not render the spinning mob inside monster spawners. Big help for spawner farms with many spawners.
silicium.option.moving_piston_distance.t: Blocks being pushed by pistons further than this are not drawn while moving (flying machines, piston farms, redstone clocks). They reappear as soon as they stop.
silicium.option.lava_effects_percent.too: Percentage of lava pops, lava particles and lava ambient sounds. Big help in the Nether and near lava lakes. 100% = vanilla.
silicium.option.water_effects_percent.to: Percentage of underwater particles and flowing water sounds. Helps near oceans, rivers and water farms. 100% = vanilla.
silicium.option.drip_particle_percent.to: Percentage of water and lava drips falling from ceilings (caves, under lakes, the Nether). 100% = vanilla.
silicium.option.block_effects_density.to: Every tick the game checks 1334 random blocks around you for effects (torch smoke, fire, leaves, lava, fireflies...). This lowers how many are checked - less CPU work every tick and fewer particles everywhere. 100% = vanilla.
silicium.option.leaf_particle_percent.to: Percentage of falling leaf particles (also cherry petals and drips from leaves in rain). Big help in forests. 100% = vanilla.
silicium.option.ambient_particle_percent: Percentage of biome ambient particles: ash in Basalt Deltas, crimson and warped spores, white ash, underwater particles in some biomes. 100% = vanilla.
silicium.option.opaque_water.tooltip: Draws water like a solid block instead of a see-through one - translucent water is one of the most expensive things to render. Waterfalls: only falling water (waterfalls and huge water walls like on big servers) is opaque, oceans, rivers and lakes stay normal. Everywhere: all water is opaque except near you (see the option below) - fastest, but big water areas look flat.
silicium.option.opaque_water_near_distan: Water closer than this stays normal and see-through (also waterfalls in Waterfalls mode), water further away is drawn opaque. Works per chunk section, so the border is a bit blocky. Off = no exception near you.
